title: Lovely Dense German Sausage Stew
description: A smoky and dense German stew featuring unwaxed lemon and pickle, perfect for a nostalgic dinner
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and cook the German sausage until browned
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened
Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for 5 minutes
Add the chicken broth, smoked paprika, and juiced unwaxed lemon to the pot
Return the cooked sausage to the pot and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
Stir in the chopped pickle and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
